text:
Eli (Docs): Hey all, opened PR to tidy up the model catalog entry for redwood/mistral-7b. Focus: clarify supported limits, add a short perf row, include SDK snippets, and add a one-paragraph compatibility note for quant variants. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/501

docs-bot: PR #501 created: docs/model-catalog/mistral-7b update (Eli (Docs))

Nora (ML): Quick results from validation rig (A100, warm kv): 512 -> 7.0 ms/token median, 2048 -> 10.1 ms/token median. Peak mem ~9.5GB @512, ~18GB @2048. I'll attach CSV to the PR shortly. Note: quant fallback adds ~10% latency in our runs.

Devon (Runtime): Please add compatibility line: "Quant variants may execute float kernels on some CUDA/driver combos; recommended minimum CUDA >=11.8 and driver >=528.x. Fallback log looks like: [runtime] WARN fallback: quant_kernels_unavailable" Also mention continuous_batching OOM fallback behavior.

Zack (SDK): Adding two snippets (py/ts) — reminder to use model_version to pin. Python sample returns text under `output_text`. I'll push in a follow-up commit.

Priya (DocsOps): Small editorial: change "max tokens" to "max context" in limits table and add a one-line customer-facing troubleshooting blurb we can copy into support templates.

Eli (Docs): Will incorporate: limits (max context 8192, recommend <=4096 for lower latency), bench row, compatibility paragraph, SDK snippets, and the CS blurb. Leaving PR as draft until Nora's CSV and Zack's commit land. Tagging for review when ready. :white_check_mark:
